reviews.rationale: This is clearly authored, business-specific work with an assured editorial grid, excellent architectural photography and unusually disciplined content editing. It is strong professional output rather than benchmark-class: the mobile layouts mostly collapse the desktop system into one column, interaction states are not evidenced, and several long pages repeat the same project and footer rhythms.

criterionScores.note: The restrained palette, alternating editorial grid, oversized imagery, fine rules and contrasting sans/serif system form a coherent thesis rooted in architectural conservation and material honesty.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The visual thesis is sophisticated but familiar within high-end architecture portfolios, and repeated project modules make the authorship less surprising over a full scroll.

criterionScores.note: Project outcomes, planning constraints, material schedules, problem-and-response narratives, staff responsibilities and the free diagnostic conversation all shape the structure rather than merely filling generic sections.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The underlying portfolio grammar could still serve another serious architecture practice, even though it would be actively unsuitable for most other sectors.
positiveEvidence: Each project is framed through a concrete architectural constraint and measurable result such as first-submission consent, reduced glazing, airtightness or acoustic performance.
Project pages pair the problem, intervention, materials and client evidence in a structure specific to architectural practice.
The enquiry guidance asks for planning history, site timing and budget rather than using a generic lead form.

criterionScores.note: The small route set is intelligible: Home establishes the proposition and selected evidence, Work provides the index, project routes provide technical depth, Studio establishes accountability, and Enquiries converts interest.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Home and Work substantially repeat the same four projects, while the long project-index and studio pages offer limited secondary navigation or cross-linking beyond the next-project prompt.

criterionScores.note: Every page establishes a decisive first read, then moves cleanly through proposition, image, evidence and action. Project titles, outcomes and photographs change emphasis appropriately across index and detail contexts.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The repeated metadata-title-description-rule-result construction becomes predictable, and some wide-screen supporting copy is very small relative to the dominant images.

criterionScores.note: Type is used compositionally: large sans-serif propositions establish modern directness, serif project titles and outcomes add editorial authority, and tracked metadata creates a disciplined technical register.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: At wide widths, metadata, captions and footer copy become excessively diminutive, and the type system does not reach the exceptional precision or expressive range of the reference.

criterionScores.note: The desktop and wide pages use alternating image/text placement, deliberate overlaps, large releases of space and occasional dark tonal interruption to compose a convincing long-form sequence.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The project index settles into a repeated alternation, while mobile loses most of the lateral tension and becomes a lengthy sequence of similarly spaced blocks.

criterionScores.note: Photography is the correct material and is treated as evidence: exterior form, interior organisation, construction character and before-or-secondary views are given enough scale to substantiate the written claims.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Some mobile hero crops sacrifice architectural completeness, and the detail pages rely on only two principal images rather than building a richer visual argument through drawings, plans or construction details.
positiveEvidence: Full-width project heroes make the building itself the dominant proof rather than surrounding it with decorative interface.
Secondary images directly support the stated intervention, such as the retained barn structure, shaded rear bay and adaptable restaurant joinery.
Crops remain coherent and subject-aware across desktop, tablet and phone.

criterionScores.note: Navigation, underlined active states, links and large CTAs appear consistent and usable, but the screenshots provide no evidence of hover, focus, transition, image interaction or other dynamic behaviour.
The layouts remain highly legible at every width, image crops are reconsidered, desktop side-by-side structures stack in sensible reading order, and mobile CTAs become full-width.

The combination of material-led photography, sober typography, conservation-minded copy and quiet technical evidence feels specifically right for a serious Bristol architecture practice concerned with repair and restraint.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The language is highly appropriate but still belongs to a recognisable contemporary architecture-studio idiom rather than becoming completely proprietary.
positiveEvidence: The visual restraint echoes the firm's stated preference for repairing and extending what exists.
Muted colours and material-rich images communicate seriousness without luxury clichés.
Planning history, technical outcomes and named practitioners create an unusually credible professional tone.

criterionScores.note: The practice, location, project type, differentiator and next action are explicit. Repeated contextual CTAs and the enquiry page explain what the first conversation is for and what information helps.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The invalid email address visibly prevents real conversion in this prototype, and project cards do not visibly signal their clickability in static evidence.

criterionScores.note: The site avoids gradients, rounded-card systems, icon triplets, fake logo walls, decorative blobs and vague innovation copy. Its components are justified by projects, evidence, people and architectural material.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The oversized minimalist headline, KPI-style facts and dark testimonial band are familiar contemporary patterns, even though they are substantially better justified here than in generic generated work.
positiveEvidence: Metrics are project-specific outcomes with explanatory captions rather than invented vanity statistics.
Editorial asymmetry and image placement replace generic card grids.
Copy consistently names buildings, constraints, materials, locations and decisions.

criterionScores.note: The memorable experience is the alternating project index in which each building photograph is paired with one terse, evidential outcome such as “First submission,” “Less glass” or “1.9 m³/h·m².”
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The signature is memorable within the category but not unique enough to be unmistakable among leading editorial architecture portfolios.

reviews.signatureMoment: The alternating project index pairs monumental architectural photographs with terse proof statements—“First submission,” “Less glass,” “3 weeks early” and “1.9 m³/h·m²”—turning the portfolio into an argument about decisions and outcomes.

comparisons.note: The candidate has a clear editorial thesis, but the reference sustains greater compositional confidence and achieves more distinctive restraint with fewer repeated devices.
The candidate's sans/serif contrast and metadata are carefully designed, but the reference is more precise in small type, scale relationships and typographic quietness.
The candidate composes desktop pages well, yet its repeated alternating modules and stacked mobile sequence are less spatially inventive than the reference.
The candidate has an exceptionally clear route model and strong progression from proposition to index, detail, people and enquiry, although Home duplicates much of Work.
The candidate remains polished and readable but largely stacks its desktop material on mobile rather than developing a substantially new narrow-screen composition.
Visible layout and image craft are strong, but the reference demonstrates finer typographic and compositional resolution; interaction craft cannot be compared confidently from still screenshots.
The evidence-led outcome captions give the candidate a memorable idea, but the reference's overall compositional identity is more unmistakable.
The candidate structurally integrates planning histories, technical performance, materials, staff accountability and consultation guidance, making the business proposition unusually explicit.

reviews.benchmarkGapDetail: Nowhere near benchmark class. The reference is stronger on most dimensions and by a wide margin.

evidenceCeiling.detail: Evidence covers 55 route(s) at 4 viewport(s): a benchmark claim about a website needs the website: several routes, at more than one width. This caps any overall claim at 10.
